name: GA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Sanford Bishop seeking re-election with a large fundraising edge
District leans Democratic with a +4 partisan lean
Challenger Matt Day raised only about $217,000 with no cash on hand
Prediction markets price Bishop's win probability around 94%
model.rationale: Bishop is a long-serving incumbent in a Democratic-leaning district, has raised over $1.1 million versus roughly $217,000 for Day, and markets price him near 94% to win. With no polls or expert ratings available, the fundamentals-based margin of roughly 18 points stands.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or significant outside spending against Bishop would warrant revisiting the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Southwest Georgia's 2nd District has re-elected Democrat Sanford Bishop repeatedly, and he returns this cycle with a decisive financial advantage, having raised over $1.1 million and holding about $448,000 on hand. Republican challenger Matt Day has raised roughly $217,000 and reports no cash on hand, with no outside spending on either side.

The district's partisan lean favors Democrats by about four points, and the incumbent advantage plus the fundraising gap point to a comfortable Bishop win. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so confidence rests on fundamentals and prediction markets, which price Bishop around 94%.
